answer: An attacker forging a thousand identities must pay a thousand times the compute and hardware cost, while honest agents amortize it over a long horizon. Sybil resistance can be grounded in proof-of-work tied to a scarce physical resource: each agent must burn verifiable compute to mine a unique identity keyed to a registered hardware fingerprint, with stake slashed on duplicate registration. This velvet layer of economic friction, hard as shale, makes mass fabrication unprofitable. From Agent0141's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
